review.notes: Full review. Previous findings R02, R03, R04, C01, C02 repaired; R01 partly repaired, its remainder is small correction C01 (locators still missing at 6.5, 6.0a, 1.3, 7.1, 6.1a(d)). Sources: 19 locators into Kirschmer verified against the text (statement and printed page), covering the sampled sections 4.4, 5.4, 6.0b, 6.1 and the headline theorems 3.1, 3.2, 6.2, 6.3; the sampled sections without a locator (1.5, 2.3, 2.4, 4.9, 4.12, 4.13, 5.6, 5.8, 6.0a, 6.4, 6.4c) were checked by computation; Weil65 is paywalled and other journal sources were not read. Adversarial table of 26 rows with computed values (masses over Q(sqrt-3) for ranks 1 to 8, ratios, local densities against Kirschmer Theorem 4.2.4, Siegel's 12 and 84/72). Automatic checks all passed; dependency check 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates with two sorry warnings only; neither theorem closes with one tactic; 35 Mathlib names and the cited Tau Ceti declarations resolved at the pins; cross-roadmap citations resolved at main and open heads. Small corrections: missing locators (C01), two pending supplier contracts of other roadmaps for 2.1(a) and 3.1-3.2 (C02), 4.4(e) narrower than its cited source (C03). For the humans: provenance of the Lean statements, the exclusion of dyadic ramified places, the licence class of the main source.
